Archival Dispatch: 14 Master Broadcasts Dated Across The Hillbilly Boys, AFRS Showtime, and Grand Ole Opry

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 3 min
Tags: The Hillbilly Boys, W Lee ODaniel, Western Swing, AFRS Showtime, Grand Ole Opry, Red Foley, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 18 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 18 resolves 14 classic American musical broadcasts spanning three traditions: W. Lee 'Pappy' O'Daniel's pioneer 1935 western swing transcription series with The Hillbilly Boys (broadcasting from Fort Worth, Texas for Hillbilly Flour), Armed Forces Radio Service's 1948 Broadway musical anthology Showtime (featuring Betty Grable, Dan Dailey, Janet Blair, and Jimmy McHugh), and live WSM Nashville broadcasts of the Grand Ole Opry.

1. The Hillbilly Boys — 1935 Texas Western Swing Master Discs

Recorded in Fort Worth, Texas, featuring early western swing fiddle and acoustic swing breakdowns:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Musical Selections
Hillbilly_Boys_Goin_Back_To_Texas.mp3 "Goin' Back to Texas (W. Lee O'Daniel Flour Co.)" 1935-10-14 Signature western swing theme and Texas hill country fiddle tunes.
Hillbilly_Boys_Hoppin_Lucy.mp3 "Hoppin' Lucy (Pat O'Daniel and His Hillbilly Boys)" 1935-10-16 Fast-tempo fiddle breakdown featuring Pat O'Daniel's band.
Hillbilly_Boys_Chawing_Chewing_Gum.mp3 "Chawin' Chewing Gum" 1935-10-18 Comic novelty hillbilly swing song with twin fiddle accompaniment.
Hillbilly_Boys_Milenberg_Joys.mp3 "Milenberg Joys" 1935-10-21 Early country-jazz fusion arrangement of the Jelly Roll Morton standard.
Hillbilly_Boys_Speed_The_Plow.mp3 "Speed the Plow" 1935-10-23 Traditional American reel transformed into a driving western swing stomp.

2. Showtime — AFRS Broadway & Hollywood Musical Adaptations (1948)

Half-hour condensed Broadway musicals produced for American military personnel:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Production Highlights
Showtime_Ziegfeld_Follies.mp3 "Showtime: Ziegfeld Follies (Janet Blair Subs for Dinah Shore)" 1948-03-21 Janet Blair hosts the greatest musical numbers from the Ziegfeld Follies.
Showtime_The_Red_Mill.mp3 "Showtime: Victor Herbert's 'The Red Mill'" 1948-04-18 Victor Herbert's classic operetta adapted with full orchestral score.
Showtime_Great_Day.mp3 "Showtime: Vincent Youmans' 'Great Day'" 1948-05-16 Hit show tunes from the 1929 Broadway musical by Vincent Youmans.
Showtime_Girl_From_Utah.mp3 "Showtime: The Girl from Utah (H-20-236)" 1948-06-20 Jerome Kern's classic score including They Didn't Believe Me.
Showtime_Mother_Wore_Tights.mp3 "Showtime: Mother Wore Tights (Betty Grable & Dan Dailey)" 1948-07-18 Radio adaptation of the 20th Century Fox musical hit.
Showtime_International_Review.mp3 "Showtime: International Review (Guest: Jimmy McHugh)" 1948-08-15 Songwriter Jimmy McHugh performs On the Sunny Side of the Street.
Showtime_Strike_Up_The_Band.mp3 "Showtime: Strike Up the Band (Marilyn Maxwell, DJ)" 1948-09-12 Gershwin musical showcase hosted by Marilyn Maxwell.
